description: This file defines a class 'Locations' within the 'Step\u Acceptance' namespace, providing acceptance test steps related to creating event locations in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to interact with the application's UI to create a location with various details, utilizing other page object classes like EditView, DetailView, and SideBar.

classes.name: Locations
classes.description: A class providing acceptance test steps for creating location entities within the SuiteCRM application, facilitating UI interactions for setting up locations with various attributes.

methods.name: createEventLocation
methods.description: Creates an event location by filling out the location form with a name and faker-based data, and saves it.
